lesson.name: Learn the Ruy Lopez Berlin Defense
lesson.description: The Berlin Defense is one of the most popular and solid defenses against 1.e4. Learn the key ideas for both White and Black in this key opening.

{White has traded pieces to try to win the e5 pawn. How should you respond?} 
4... dxc6 {[%wrong White keeps a material advantage. Try to find a stronger
move.] [%hint Recapture and let your queen and c8 bishop develop soon.]} (4...
bxc6 $5 {This is OK, but most players choose another recapture. What is it?})
5. Nxe5 {Good start! What's the best way to win back the lost pawn?} Qd4 {
[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try to find it.] [%hint Fork the e5 knight
and e4 pawn.]} (5... Nxe4 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's an even better
move. Try to find it.}) (5... Bd6 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's an even
better move. Try to find it.}) 6. Nf3 {Good move! How should you capture on e4?
} Qxe4+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find it.] [%hint Save your
queen and capture a pawn.] Great work! Black has equalized material and can
prevent White from castling.} (6... Nxe4 $2 7. Nxd4 {White wins the queen. Try
again.}) *

White is doing well. Try to find a better move.] [%hint Capture an undefended
piece.]} (7... Qxb2 $5 {This is a good move, but there's an even better one.
Try to find it.}) 8. d4 {Nice move! The fork wins back a piece for White, but
Black is still better. How should you save your queen?} Qxe4 {[%wrong There's
a better option. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture an undefended pawn.]} (8...
Bb4+ $5 {This is a good move, but there's an even better one. Try to find it.})
9. dxc5 {Good work! What should you capture next?} Qxg2 {[%wrong There's a
better attacking move. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture an undefended pawn.]
Great play! Black has more pawns and the safer king.} (9... Bg4 $5 {Black is
doing well, but there's an even better move. Try to find it.}) (9... Bh3 $5 {
Black is doing well, but there's an even better move. Try to find it.}) (9...
Nd5 $5 {Black is doing well, but there's an even better move. Try to find it.})
(9... Qb4+ $2 10. Qd2 {After Qxb2 and Bd4, Black is only slightly better. Try
to find a stronger move.}) *
